name: Lucid Voice
description: The Lucid Voice was a Providence-class Dreadnought that served within the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Throughout the war, the dreadnought saw action in several contested star systems, such as the systems of Quell and Ryloth, and participated in a space battle alongside several Munificent-class star frigates against at least three Venator-class Star Destroyers of the Galactic Republic.
